'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Casey Anis LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Casey Anis]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Communing (Virtual Block 7)|Communing]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
